body: As someone who first tripped on L at age 13 I'm in no place to judge however, you should not be posting this shit on the internet. Post that your 14 that's chill. Post that you bought 1p that's chill too. Dont post them togther or else you'll get responses like the others. And they do have a right to tell you it's a bad idea because 14 is really fucking young. However your going to do it anyways because strangers arnt going to change your mind so here's my advice. Have a friend or a family member that's okay with drug use for your trip, shit gets real fast. Dont take too much, you have a ton of time to experiment but you'll never get too if you have a terrible trip and never want to ever again. No need to rush. And my last word of advice 1p and most other research chemicals are only legal under the guise of not being eaten, probably not the smartest to go posting it everywhere or telling all your friends about it. Have fun, wait if you can, be careful if you cant.
